title: Warm Middle Eastern Daikon Shakshuka
description: A tangy and crumbly Middle Eastern dish featuring daikon and bhuna, perfect for a cozy meal. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional shakshuka.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast iron skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced daikon and cook until it is tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the bhuna spice blend and cook for one minute.
Add the canned diced tomatoes and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Create four wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Season the eggs with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
